about.title: About me
about.p1: I started programming at 15 on my own, with no courses or tutors. Today I study Computer Engineering at UNED and have spent 7 years building things that matter to me.
about.p2: I founded Xenon.py with a conviction: Equatorial Guinea deserves software built for its own reality, not adaptations from other contexts. Every project I build starts from there.
about.p3: I specialize in web and desktop development. Outside of code, you'll find me doing 3D design, drawing, or playing chess.
